channel.title: Zhihe (Bob) Zhao — Writing
channel.description: Technical notes and essays on personal AI, memory, and building useful products.

item.title: After Muse and Today, What Is Still Missing?
item.description: As personal agents become better at doing things, deciding what is worth doing becomes more important.

item.title: Don’t Make Me Teach My AI Twice
item.description: The value of memory appears in the next result, when an old correction saves new work.

item.title: Is There a Business Beyond Productivity?
item.description: Emotional value can be real. A product still has to earn a second use and pay for its own delivery.

item.title: My AI and I Lost the Reader
item.description: Shared context can make two collaborators forget the person they are writing for.

item.title: Who Keeps the Promise an AI Makes?
item.description: A polished draft can quietly commit its sender to something they never decided.

item.title: The Refusal My AI Edited Away
item.description: Good rewriting preserves what a sentence does, as well as what it says.

item.title: Not Every Day Is an Epiphany
item.description: An AI-generated interpretation of a life should not quietly become evidence about that life.

item.title: Personal AI Needs a Right to Change Your Mind
item.description: Long-term understanding should make it easier to revise an arrangement, not harder to escape an old profile.

item.title: Did Memory Actually Change the Decision?
item.description: A practical way to distinguish memory access, behavioral influence, and user value.

item.title: A Citation Is Not Enough: Who Does This Fact Belong To?
item.description: Source support, speaker identity, and autobiographical truth are different checks.

item.title: When an Agent Does Nothing, What Actually Happened?
item.description: Evaluating restraint requires an opportunity to act—and an honest account of failures.

item.title: Agent Capabilities Don’t Have to Be Modules
item.description: Fix the boundaries that must hold. Let task structure earn its complexity.

item.title: Relevant Doesn’t Mean Usable: Context for Personal AI
item.description: Context selection has to consider time, uncertainty, purpose, and the person receiving the result.

item.title: A User Correction Is Not a Global Preference
item.description: Feedback needs an object, a scope, and a way to check whether the next behavior improved.
